_meta.note: QCOs (Quality Control Orders) are issued under Section 16 of the BIS Act, 2016, mostly by DPIIT but also by sectoral ministries. As of 2026 there are ~187 QCOs covering ~769 product categories, and new orders are notified on a rolling basis -- this table is illustrative, not exhaustive. In production this must be a maintained/refreshable feed (e.g. re-scraped from DPIIT/BIS notifications on a schedule), not a static file, since new QCOs (furniture, cookware, bearings, etc.) have been added through 2025-2026.
